en-US.author: David V. Kimball
en-US.description: A calm place to write for your Astro site.
en-US.longDescription: Zeku is a native markdown editor for Astro sites. It opens your project's content folder and reads the collections in content.config.ts, so the frontmatter form matches your schema. Write in live-preview markdown, see the real page through your own astro dev, run SEO checks, and publish with your own git. 14-day free trial, and nothing locks after it.
en-US.name: Zeku
